correctness.rationale: For distinct sides the affine incidence polynomial and exact integrals give the stated continuous Q. For same sides at scale one, straddling the tangency midpoint has conditional probability 1/2, producing an extra mass of sum_i p_i^2/2. The full-scale shape coefficient 1/2−Q(1) is strictly negative. Finite symbolic, quadrature and physical-segment diagnostics supplement the analytic proof.
